body.zh: 根据设施参考图的 PEJABAT ADMIN 标注，对照原校园底图定位。具体办公入口请以现场标示为准。
body.en: Located using the PEJABAT ADMIN label on the reference map. Follow on-site signs for the office entrance.
body.ms: Lokasi berdasarkan label PEJABAT ADMIN pada peta rujukan. Ikuti papan tanda untuk pintu masuk pejabat.

body.zh: 根据设施参考图的 JPH 标注，对照原校园底图定位。具体办公室或课室入口仍需确认。
body.en: Located using the JPH label on the reference map. Office and classroom entrances need confirmation.
body.ms: Lokasi berdasarkan label JPH pada peta rujukan. Pintu masuk pejabat dan kelas perlu disahkan.

body.zh: 根据原图 Pusat Islam Politeknik Muadzam Shah 标记定位。
body.en: Located using the Pusat Islam marker on the original map.
body.ms: Lokasi berdasarkan penanda Pusat Islam pada peta asal.

body.zh: 根据原图左下方体育设施图钉定位，附近可见运动场。
body.en: Located using the sports marker at the lower left of the original map, near the field.
body.ms: Lokasi berdasarkan penanda sukan di kiri bawah peta asal, berhampiran padang.

body.zh: 根据原图顶部文字与图钉标注；该区域靠近图片上边缘。
body.en: Located using the label and marker near the top edge of the original map.
body.ms: Lokasi berdasarkan label dan penanda berhampiran bahagian atas peta asal.

body.zh: 根据原图中可见的椭圆形跑道标注，正式场地名称与入口待确认。
body.en: Marked at the oval track visible on the original map. The official venue name and entrance need confirmation.
body.ms: Ditanda pada trek bujur dalam peta asal. Nama rasmi tempat dan pintu masuk perlu disahkan.

body.zh: Mini Library 位于 Aras 1（1 楼）的 Bilik Studio UIDM；请从楼内前往。
body.en: Mini Library is on Level 1 (Aras 1), in Bilik Studio UIDM. Access it from inside the building.
body.ms: Mini Library terletak di Aras 1, Bilik Studio UIDM. Masuk melalui bahagian dalam bangunan.

body.zh: 位于男女生宿舍附近，从标有 “Love Kamsis” 的入口直走即可到达。
body.en: Near the male and female hostels; walk straight from the entrance marked “Love Kamsis”.
body.ms: Berhampiran asrama lelaki dan perempuan; berjalan terus dari pintu masuk bertanda “Love Kamsis”.

body.zh: 周一至周五营业，07:00–16:30；周末非营业。
body.en: Open Monday–Friday, 07:00–16:30; closed on weekends.
body.ms: Buka Isnin–Jumaat, 07:00–16:30; tutup pada hujung minggu.

body.zh: 位于 Bizz Mall。
body.en: Located at Bizz Mall.
body.ms: Terletak di Bizz Mall.

body.zh: 校园内的日常用餐地点。各店铺营业安排可能不同。
body.en: A place for everyday meals on campus. Individual stalls may have different hours.
body.ms: Tempat makan harian di kampus. Waktu setiap gerai mungkin berbeza.

body.zh: 位于学生事务处（HEP）楼下，可购买文具和日常小食，也可复印文件。
body.en: Downstairs at HEP, selling stationery and snacks and offering photocopying.
body.ms: Di tingkat bawah HEP, menjual alat tulis dan makanan ringan serta menyediakan fotokopi.

body.zh: 洗衣服务位于学生宿舍内。不同宿舍的设备及支付方式可能不同，请到所在宿舍查看。
body.en: Laundry is inside the hostels. Machines and payment methods vary; check your own hostel.
body.ms: Dobi berada dalam asrama. Mesin dan kaedah bayaran berbeza; semak di asrama anda.

body.zh: 位于 Bizz Mall 旁边、女生宿舍后方。地图关联 Bizz Mall 区域，抵达后请到旁边的洗衣设施。
body.en: Beside Bizz Mall, behind female hostel . The map points to Bizz Mall; find the laundry beside it.
body.ms: Di sebelah Bizz Mall, belakang asrama perempuan . Peta merujuk kawasan Bizz Mall; cari dobi di sebelahnya.

body.zh: 校园小型购物区域之一，Pusat Parcel 包裹中心位于这里。
body.en: A small campus shopping area containing Pusat Parcel.
body.ms: Kawasan kedai kecil kampus yang menempatkan Pusat Parcel.

body.zh: 根据设施参考图中的 JKM 区域标注。
body.en: Marked using the JKM area on the facility reference map.
body.ms: Ditanda berdasarkan kawasan JKM pada peta kemudahan.

body.zh: 根据设施参考图中的 JRKV 标注；具体办公室及课室资料待补充。
body.en: Marked using the JRKV label; office and classroom details are pending.
body.ms: Ditanda berdasarkan label JRKV; butiran pejabat dan kelas belum diberikan.

body.zh: 根据设施参考图中的 JTMK 区域标注。
body.en: Marked using the JTMK area on the facility reference map.
body.ms: Ditanda berdasarkan kawasan JTMK pada peta kemudahan.

body.zh: 根据设施参考图中校园中心的 HEP 标注。与行政办公室分开标示。
body.en: Marked using the central HEP label, separately from the administration office.
body.ms: Ditanda berdasarkan label HEP di pusat kampus, berasingan daripada pejabat pentadbiran.

title.zh: JP / JPA / JMSK 教学区域

body.zh: 参考图将这一区域标为 JP / JPA / JMSK，具体部门入口待补充。
body.en: The reference map labels this area JP / JPA / JMSK. Department entrances are pending.
body.ms: Peta rujukan melabel kawasan ini JP / JPA / JMSK. Pintu masuk jabatan belum disahkan.

body.zh: 星期一至五营业，早上 8 点到下午 5 点。
body.en: Open Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm.
body.ms: Dibuka Isnin hingga Jumaat, 8 pagi hingga 5 petang.

body.zh: 男生宿舍：Block 1–5。女生宿舍：Block A–E。报到时先确认自己的 Block 和房号，再跟着现场标示找宿舍。地图目前标示宿舍区域，尚未逐栋定位。

body.ms: Asrama lelaki: Blok 1–5. Asrama perempuan: Blok A–E.Sahkan blok dan nombor bilik semasa pendaftaran, kemudian ikut papan tanda. Peta kini menandakan kawasan asrama, bukan setiap blok.

body.zh: 位于旅游与酒店管理系（JPH）旁，地图位置依据你提供的圈选区域标注。
body.en: Beside the Tourism & Hospitality Department (JPH). Map position follows the supplied reference.
body.ms: Bersebelahan Jabatan Pelancongan dan Hospitaliti (JPH). Kedudukan peta berdasarkan rujukan yang diberikan.

title.zh: 入住前，学长姐的小提醒

body.en: Student tips before moving inSenior student’s experienceCheck your room when moving in When moving in, check the lights, fan, door lock, plumbing and wardrobe. Photograph any damage, then contact a Felo or the assigned senior student with your block, room number and details of the damage. What if something in the room is broken? During orientation, ask a Felo or the assigned senior students for help with broken lights, fans, plumbing, door locks or other room equipment. Give your block, room number and a description of the problem. Rooms and bathrooms Hostels have two-person and four-person rooms. Each floor has two shared bathroom areas, each with at least three toilet cubicles and three shower cubicles. Bring your own cleaning supplies Bring a broom, bin, bin bags and other cleaning supplies; these are usually not provided. Coordinate shared supplies with your roommates. Feeling unwell? Contact Felo-on-call If you are ill, call the duty Felo-on-call and state your block, room number and situation. Check the latest hostel duty roster for the number. You can bring a printer According to student-shared information, printers are allowed and students can offer paid printing or photocopying in the hostel; arrangements remain subject to hostel management requirements. Return on time after outings Students report that returning after the permitted outing time results in a fine and confiscation of the student card. Confirm your return deadline and allow time for transport; actual disciplinary action is determined by the institution. For a more comfortable sleepConsider bringing a pillow you are comfortable with. The above accommodation tips were shared by a student on 3 October 2026; they are not an official rulebook. Information updated: 2026-10-03

body.en: New-student FAQsSenior student’s experienceWhat if something in the room is broken?During orientation, ask a Felo or the assigned senior students for help with broken lights, fans, plumbing, door locks or other room equipment. Give your block, room number and a description of the problem.Is there a bus for local outings?For local outings, use Grab or a taxi; there is currently no bus service. Confirm a ride before leaving and arrange your return in advance.Which semester can I bring a vehicle?Apply through SPMP or at HEP: motorcycles from Semester 2 and cars from Semester 3. Complete the application and confirm approval before parking according to campus requirements.Students of any semester may choose off-campus parking. It is unsupervised, so you are responsible for your vehicle and belongings. This does not grant permission to bring a vehicle onto campus.Which blocks are male and female hostels?Male hostels: Blocks 1–5. Female hostels: Blocks A–E.Where do I collect parcels?Open the parcel lookup report and find your name, order number and Bakul (basket) number. Note them down, then go to Pusat Parcel at Bizz Mall and give the counter the last four digits of your phone number to collect your parcel.Monday–Thursday and Sunday: 09:30–18:00; Friday: 09:30–12:20 and 14:40–18:00; closed Saturday.Where can I print, photocopy or buy stationery?Café Siber (Cyber Café) is downstairs at HEP and offers photocopying and stationery. Cafe Koi's sign also lists printing and photocopying; confirm availability with the shop.Where can I buy a laundry card?Buy at the laundry card machine at the Coop Mart entrance. RM25 includes the RM5 card fee and RM20 credit; follow the price shown on the machine.How does hostel laundry differ from Bizz Mall laundry?Hostel machines are inside the hostels. Bizz Mall laundry is beside the mall, behind female hostel . Fees and payment methods differ.What do I need to go out, and when must I return?Bring your student card and wear collared clothing, long trousers and closed shoes. Gate hours: Monday–Thursday 08:00–19:00; Friday–Sunday 08:00–22:00. Entry and exit pause Friday 12:00–14:00. Follow school notices for changes.Which places may close at weekends?Most cafeteria stalls may close at weekends and holidays. Café Siber's weekend hours are unconfirmed. Coop Mart has weekend sessions; see its details.Where is the library?Mini Library is on Level 1 (Aras 1), in Bilik Studio UIDM. Access it from inside the building.Can I use the pool at any time?No. Sessions are separated by day, gender and student/staff group. Friday is closed, and weekend courses may cause closures. Check your group's session and the day's arrangements.Information updated: 2026-10-03
